RESUME_DATA.name: Mark Mikhalev
RESUME_DATA.about: AI Automation Engineer | Business Process Analyst | Team Lead
summary: I create work environments where intelligent automation enables teams to focus on the work they can enjoy and thrive.

My diverse background provides me with a skill set that benefits both digital and traditional projects. I am equally comfortable working with code and with people, managing hybrid teams, and building data-driven AI-enabled systems that lighten the load and boost teams' efficiency and well-being.

Starting my path in HoReCa, I learned to manage teams of diverse backgrounds, resolve conflicts, and help people with a smile on my face under any circumstance. My passion for tech led me to IT, and the first opportunity to apply my skills came in with the content-farming boom. I started working as a copywriter for a local project with a distributed team and was quickly promoted to an editor, owning the entire SEO content production cycle.

After the project ended, I taught myself digital marketing. I did freelance, sharpening my skills, before joining Instaon as Customer Success Manager. This experience provided a chance to work with a LLM for digital ad creation and have a peek at the change that was coming to our workplace, before the public GPT release. Since then I have been waiting for the moment the AI becomes mature enough to transform the abundance culture from the sci-fi motif to a real promise. This moment has come. Today I apply agentic AI to drive teams’ growth and human success.

If you need someone autonomous, quick to spot areas for growth and act on them, you’re in the right place at the right time because I'm open to offers. It would be great to find a team of like-minded people to build long-term relationships with and, through little feats, score big wins. You can find an outline of my tech experience below, or download my CV here.

Does it feel like a good match with your wants and needs? Wanna talk or offer me a role in your project? Hit one of those contact buttons on the right to drop me a line or book a time on my calendar for a quick chat. I’ll be happy to hear from you and talk about things we can make better, faster, and stronger.
